_comment: THE authoritative DailyDialog spec (review ruling 2026-09-21): frozen_method.json is the single formal spec for the LLaMA DailyDialog line.  The R8/R10-era file is archived as frozen_method_r10_legacy.json — it described the OLD protocol (single penultimate cut v=k-3, Gamma from t=2, trainable LoRA+COMP, lambda 0.00594) and must NOT be used as the method identity anymore.  lambda_kf is null until the ONE recalibration on the fixed code is committed here. GEMMA4 VARIANT (2026-09-23): the gemma Stage-2 resume runs the official 1000-step recipe — training.steps=700 (resume 300 -> 700, user ruling) and checkpoint_every=50 (the llama/qwen3 formal lines keep steps=60).
frozen_source: review ruling 2026-09-21 (cut collector / Gamma placement / raw-turn chi-phi / freeze-host / validation-only selection); supersedes the R10 legacy spec

backbone.host_path: official host ONLY: build_official_host (Step-1 foundation merged + released Step-2 compression adapter + SeparatedEmbedding COMP rows); the legacy resize host is not the DailyDialog method

adapter.lora_r_note: LoRA rank for the conditional adapter (r=8 fixed for the formal runs)
adapter.official_adapter: released Step-2 compression adapter dir (env OFFICIAL_ADAPTER at eval; CLI --official-adapter at train)

lambda_calibration.rule: R10 gamma-scope calibration (review 2026-09-16): lambda = 0.1 / r_eff measured on the GAMMA group only at theta_0, first full window, before ANY optimizer step
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: NULL PENDING RECALIBRATION (review ruling 2026-09-21): the old 0.005936691082765761 was calibrated under the retired protocol (single penultimate cut, Gamma from t=2, trainable LoRA+COMP scope).  The fixed protocol changed the cut set (t=1..L), the Gamma placement (M_0=0) and the trainable scope (Gamma only), so the gradient geometry is different.  Recalibrate ONCE on the fixed code and commit the derived lambda here.  The trainer refuses the ours arm while this field is null.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_t) fixed adapter at block_idx = t - 1 for t = 1..L (one cut per actual compression layer; review ruling 2026-09-21)
rpbe.cut_supervision: t < L: obs1 (C=u_{t+1}, Y=u_{t+2}, w=0.5) + obs2 (C=(u_{t+1}, u_{t+2}, one-update), Y=y, w=0.5); t = L: single row (C=c, Y=y, w=1.0).  chi/phi are built from the RAW tokenized turns [u_1..u_L, c, y], never from spans of the collated ids.
rpbe.sketch_ensemble_note: four independent 32-dim branches (J_ens = mean_r J_r; never concatenated into one 128-dim covariance).  Depth bucket b(L) modulates the future signature with LOCAL cut depth L=t in 1..13.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots; recurrence M_t = mean(h_1..h_t) + R_Gamma(M_{t-1}, h_t, t) for EVERY t = 1..L with M_0 = 0 (review ruling 2026-09-21: the first compression layer is inside the method, L=1 included)
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init; step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero.  Gradient note: with U_0 = 0 the first step updates only U (dR/dV vanishes at U = 0).

freeze_host.scope: backbone + conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM embeddings all frozen (train Gamma ONLY); optimizer holds only the Gamma group.  For the ours / gamma_task_only arms the trainer REFUSES to start without --freeze-host (enforce_frozen).
freeze_host.mode: host model.eval() + Gamma modules train() — the released conditional LoRA dropout (0.05) must not perturb the frozen host forward; gradients still flow through the host to Gamma

official_host.note: the DailyDialog formal arms run on the official host (build_official_host); the legacy resize host is retired for this method.  For the ours / gamma_task_only arms the trainer REFUSES to start without --official-host (enforce_frozen).

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with L>=1; review ruling 2026-09-21: L=1 emits its terminal cut)
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the three arms

training.steps_note: Review-fix protocol (2026-09-21): 60 windows, task-only / ours from the SAME theta_0 (official CCM-merge host, frozen, zero-init Gamma).  The R10-era 300-step budget belonged to the retired protocol.
training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)
training.checkpoint_selection: validation only (clean_split=True, eval_source=val).  The official val+test pooled protocol remains a CCM-reproduction report only and never selects a checkpoint.

sampling.n_turns_of_L: L + 2 TURNS (fixed prefix length in turns per depth; NOT meta.k = len(blocks)+1 = L + 1)
sampling.cut_depths: every sample at endpoint L contributes cuts at LOCAL depths t = 1..L (maps.pv depth = t; Llmmaps registers local depths 1..13, out-of-range values fail fast — no modulo fold)
sampling.rule: q_L ~ 1/sqrt(n_L) with 3x-uniform oversampling cap; ONE original dialogue per window (tree_id = stable original dialogue id).
